title: Design System: Investment Dashboard (Miro Portfolio System)

body.purpose: Primary reading size for stats, descriptions, table cells. 15px.

label.purpose: Stat labels, section eyebrows, badge text. Uppercase, max 4 words.

shadows.name: sm
shadows.purpose: Card hover state, subtle element lift.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (hover, focus, color).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Teal full-pill primary call-to-action. Default action on every screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0fbcb0; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Sora', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; text-transform: none; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0da89d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1c1e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White-filled button with hairline border. Used for secondary actions alongside the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #1c1c1e; font-family: 'Sora', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; padding: 16px 24px; border: 1px solid #e0e2e8; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f7f8fa; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c1c1e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Primary container for portfolio cards, metric panels, and content blocks.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e0e2e8; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; font-family: 'Sora', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; color: #1c1c1e; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card-value { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; color: #1c1c1e; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input with hairline border. Used in modals, forms, and search.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e0e2e8; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1c1e; font-family: 'Sora', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0fbcb0; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #77767b; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0fbcb0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Pill Link
components.description: Top navigation link. Active state is ink-filled; inactive is slate text.
components.html: Overview
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Sora', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #555a6a; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #1c1c1e; background: #f7f8fa; } .ds-nav-link-active { background: #1c1c1e; color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-link-active:hover { background: #1c1c1e; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-icon:hover { transform: scale(1.12); }

components.name: Badge / Chip
components.description: Small pill tag for portfolio type tags and status indicators.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-chip-teal { background: rgba(15,188,176,0.12); color: #0fbcb0; } .ds-chip-yellow { background: rgba(255,208,47,0.18); color: #b8960f; } .ds-chip-coral { background: rgba(255,153,153,0.18); color: #d94343; } .ds-chip-blue { background: rgba(66,98,255,0.12); color: #4262ff; } .ds-chip-neutral { background: #f7f8fa; color: #555a6a; }

components.name: Select Dropdown
components.description: Custom select trigger and dropdown with pill options.
components.html:
Managed Fund
Active Trading
Spread Strategy
components.css: .ds-select-trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e0e2e8; background: #ffffff; color: #1c1c1e; font-family: 'Sora', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease; min-width: 160px; } .ds-select-trigger:hover { border-color: #77767b; } .ds-select-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0fbcb0; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-select-dropdown { position: absolute; right: 0; margin-top: 6px; min-width: 200px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e0e2e8; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 4px 6px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); padding: 4px; z-index: 50; } .ds-select-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Sora', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1c1b1b; cursor: pointer; transition: background 100ms ease; } .ds-select-option:hover { background: #f7f8fa; } .ds-select-option.active { background: #f7f8fa; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: Small filled circle indicating status or type. Used inline in dropdowns and tables.
components.css: .ds-status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; display: inline-block; } .ds-status-dot-teal { background: #0fbcb0; } .ds-status-dot-yellow { background: #ffd02f; } .ds-status-dot-coral { background: #ff9999; } .ds-status-dot-blue { background: #4262ff; }

narrative.overview:
A workshop where every tool is within reach and every number is instantly legible. Clean white and near-white surfaces form the workbench; bold canary yellow and pastel teal/coral/blue accents provide signal without noise. This is a space for confident action — monitoring, rebalancing, transferring, closing — not decoration.

The system sits at the intersection of playful and precise. Generous rounded corners (16px on cards, full pills on buttons) and soft pastel tints keep the tool approachable, while tight typography (Sora at 15px body, crisp uppercase labels) and flat tonal layering keep the data authoritative. Depth is conveyed through background color shifts and hairline borders, not shadows — surfaces are flat at rest.
keyCharacteristics: Flat tonal depth — no ambient shadows, depth via surface color shifts
One bold accent (yellow) carries signal weight; all other colors are muted-to-accent
Full-pill buttons with generous horizontal padding
Pastel tints for status backgrounds (teal-light, coral-light, yellow-light)
Sora geometric sans throughout — one family, weight contrast carries hierarchy
16px card corners as the dominant container radius
Uppercase tracking on short labels only — never on body copy

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Brand Yellow is the only saturated accent that appears as a full surface. Every other accent (teal, coral, blue) is used as text, border, or tinted background — never as a dominant fill color.

rules.name: The No-Gradient-Rule
rules.body: Gradients on text or backgrounds are forbidden. Color is solid or it's absent.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: All text uses Sora. No serif, no mono, no secondary display face.

rules.name: The No-All-Caps-Body Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for stat labels and short badges (≤4 words). Never use all-caps for sentences, section intros, or body copy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Containers are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a structural cue or response to interaction.

dos: Do use Brand Yellow as the single bold surface — it carries signal weight because nothing else competes at that saturation.
Do use pastel tints (teal-light, coral-light, yellow-light) for status backgrounds instead of the raw saturated accent.
Do use full-pill buttons for all actions — it's the system's most recognizable shape pattern.
Do use flat containers with hairline borders at rest and tonal surface shifts for depth.
Do keep body text at 15px with a max line length of 75ch.
Do use text-wrap: balance on heading elements and text-wrap: pretty on long prose.
Do use uppercase labels only for short stat labels and badges (4 words max).
Do use Sora across the entire interface — one family, weight contrast for hierarchy.
donts: Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient). Solid color or nothing.
Don't use glassmorphism (backdrop blur on cards) as a default pattern.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left >1px as a colored accent on cards or callouts).
Don't use the hero-metric template (big number + small label + gradient accent).
Don't use numbered section markers (01 / 02 / 03) as default scaffolding above sections.
Don't use all-caps for body copy, sentences, or section introductions.
Don't use navy-and-gold fintech aesthetics, dark-mode-terminal-only looks, or SaaS-cream minimalism.
Don't stack nested cards — cards are flat by default and should not contain other cards.
Don't use fonts outside the Sora family — no serif, mono, or competing sans-serif.
Don't place uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section as a default pattern.
